lines.en: label yumidorm20:
I knock on Yumi’s door, hoping that she’s hanging out in her room rather than wandering around Kumon-mi selling stolen candy to children.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Yumi 的门，希望她此刻正待在自己房间里，而不是在 Kumon-mi 到处晃悠，把偷来的糖卖给小孩。

lines.en: It’s something I’ve never had to worry about with any of the other girls, but is a real concern to me now following our last lunch-outing.
lines.zh: 换作别的女孩，我从来不需要操心这种事，可自从上次一起出去吃午饭之后，这成了我一个真实的担忧。

lines.en: : Yeah. What?
lines.zh: : 嗯。干嘛？

lines.en: : It’s me. Can I come in?
lines.zh: : 是我。能进来吗？

lines.en: : You’re not going to pretend to be a delivery guy this time?
lines.zh: : 这次你不打算假扮外卖员了？

lines.en: : No, I think we’ve passed that point in our relationship.
lines.zh: : 不了，我觉得我们已经过了关系里的那个阶段。

lines.en: : Also, we have important things to discuss regarding the amount of food that you will be eating in the future.
lines.zh: : 另外，我们有重要的事要谈——关于你未来将要吃掉的食物总量。

lines.en: : Weird fuckin’ way to say you’re ready to teach me interview shit, but sure. Whatever.
lines.zh: : 说你准备好教我面试那套东西，方式还挺他妈怪的，不过行吧。随便。

lines.en: : Door’s open.
lines.zh: : 门开着。

lines.en: scene black
I make my way into Yumi’s room to find her sitting on her bed in her pajamas, scribbling something into a notebook...
lines.zh: 我走进 Yumi 的房间，发现她穿着睡衣坐在床上，正往一个笔记本上胡乱写着什么……

lines.en: scene yuminotebook1
: You know, I didn’t really think you were going to be taking this interview thing so seriously that it would warrant a notebook.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我真没想到你会把面试这事严肃到需要一个笔记本。

lines.en: : That was the plan, but I ran out of lead after the ‘b’ in ‘job’ so I guess I'm shit outta luck now.
lines.zh: : 本来是这么打算的，可我写到「工」字的「b」就没笔芯了，所以看来我是没辙了。

lines.en: : You can’t even afford pencil lead?
lines.zh: : 你连铅笔芯都买不起？

lines.en: : Don’t they give that out for free in the[school]?
lines.zh: : [school]不是免费发那个吗？

lines.en: : Beats me. When the fuck am I ever in[school] to begin with? How would I even know?
lines.zh: : 我怎么知道。我他妈什么时候去过[school]？我怎么会知道？

lines.en: : 'Sides, I wouldn't even know where to go for it if that was true.
lines.zh: : 再说了，就算真有这回事，我也不知道该上哪儿去领。

lines.en: : Shit, this isn’t even my pencil. I took it off Chika’s table.
lines.zh: : 操，这支铅笔都不是我的。我是从 Chika 桌上拿的。

lines.en: : You’re a mess, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 你可真是一团糟，Yumi。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook2
: Yeah, and you’re a fucking dick but you don’t see me complaining about it!
lines.zh: : 是啊，而你是个混蛋，可你没见我抱怨过吧！

lines.en: : I see you complaining about that literally every time we’re next to each other.
lines.zh: : 我们每次待在一起，你都在抱怨这个。

lines.en: : Well...stop being a dick, then!
lines.zh: : 那……那你别当混蛋啊！

lines.en: Maybe I should bring Yumi a few pencils or something if I can ever remember to do that?
lines.zh: 也许我该给 Yumi 带几支铅笔什么的——要是我能记得住的话？

lines.en: Despite how hard she’s apparently trying to find work, I can’t imagine this whole ramen shop situation is going to end in success either.
lines.zh: 尽管她看起来确实在努力找工作，我也无法想象这整件拉面店的事最后能成功。

lines.en: And if she’s actually going to apply herself, the least I can do as the person basically orchestrating all of this is to provide some of the tools she needs.
lines.zh: 而如果她是真的打算用心去做，那么作为基本上策划了这一切的人，我至少该给她提供一些需要的工具。

lines.en: If I can remember, of course. Which remains to be seen.
lines.zh: 当然，前提是我能记得。那就走着瞧了。

lines.en: : Okay, I’ll stop being a dick and go directly into teacher-mode if that's how you want to do this.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我就不当混蛋了，直接进入老师模式——如果这就是你想要的方式。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook3
: Didn't even realize that was a setting you had.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道你还有这个设置。

lines.en: : Why the fuck did it take so long to activate it?
lines.zh: : 为什么他妈的过了这么久才启动？

lines.en: : It’s still in test-mode, so apologies in advance if this doesn’t work out how I intend it to.
lines.zh: : 它还在测试模式下，所以如果结果不如我预期，我先道个歉。

lines.en: : I highly doubt it will, but go ahead. Do your thing.
lines.zh: : 我非常怀疑它会如你所愿，不过来吧。开始你的表演。

lines.en: I clear my throat and crack my knuckles. Then, teacher-mode activates.
lines.zh: 我清了清嗓子，掰了掰指关节。然后，老师模式启动了。

lines.en: : The most important part of a job interview is the first impression. Do you know what that means?
lines.zh: : 求职面试里最重要的部分是第一印象。你知道那是什么意思吗？

lines.en: scene yuminotebook4
: Uhh...probably like...bowing and shit. Right?
lines.zh: : 呃……大概是……鞠躬之类的吧。对吧？

lines.en: : And aren’t you supposed to bring a gift or something as well?
lines.zh: : 而且不还得带个礼物什么的吗？

lines.en: : That’s advanced stuff.
lines.zh: : 那是高阶内容。

lines.en: : All you really need to worry about is not tensing up so much.
lines.zh: : 你真正需要担心的，只是别太紧绷。

lines.en: : And also not threatening to kill anyone.
lines.zh: : 还有，别威胁说要杀掉任何人。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook5
: This is already stupid.
lines.zh: : 这已经够蠢了。

lines.en: : The fuck do you mean by “not tensing up so much?” Am I really that...tense looking?
lines.zh: : 「别太紧绷」是什么意思？我真有那么……看起来很紧绷吗？

lines.en: : I actually don’t think I’ve ever seen you look relaxed before.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我好像从没见你放松过。

lines.en: : Even now, you’re wearing pajamas and I still feel like you’re ready to attack me.
lines.zh: : 就算现在，你穿着睡衣，我还是觉得你随时准备扑上来攻击我。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook2
: Well, excuse me, but the guy in my room has an established track record of attacking me! So, yeah! Of course I’m going to be fucking ready to defend myself!
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉，可我房间里的这家伙有攻击我的前科！所以，对！我当然要他妈做好自卫的准备！

lines.en: : The only thing I’m going to attack you with is knowledge.
lines.zh: : 我唯一要用来攻击你的东西，是知识。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook6
: The fact that there are people I know who go out of their way to talk to you is abso-fucking-lutely mind boggling.
lines.zh: : 我认识的人里居然有人会专门跑去找你说话，真是他妈的让人费解。

lines.en: : I agree. But it is what it is and we must accept it.
lines.zh: : 我同意。但事情就是这样，我们得接受。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook7
: That aside, I've got a question. The fuck am I supposed to do if I get asked that fuckin' “Where do you see yourself in ten years” question?
lines.zh: : 先不说这个，我有个问题。要是被问到那个该死的“你觉得自己十年后会在哪里”，我他妈该怎么答？

lines.en: : I’d probably start by telling the interviewer where you see yourself in ten years.
lines.zh: : 我大概会先告诉面试官，你觉得自己十年后会在哪里。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I get that. But I’m supposed to like, lie, right?
lines.zh: : 行行行，我懂。可我应该得……撒谎，对吧？

lines.en: : Is...your answer to that question not good?
lines.zh: : 你……对那个问题的答案不好吗？

lines.en: scene yuminotebook8
: The fuck do you think?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢？

lines.en: : I’ll be lucky if I’m not in fuckin' jail in ten years. Can’t you just give me the right answer?
lines.zh: : 十年后我要是没进监狱就算走运了。你就不能直接告诉我正确答案吗？

lines.en: : There’s not really a right answer to that question. Only wrong ones.
lines.zh: : 那个问题其实没有正确答案。只有错误答案。

lines.en: : Well, give me an example of a wrong one, then.
lines.zh: : 那给我举一个错误答案的例子。

lines.en: : I probably wouldn’t mention the jail thing, to start.
lines.zh: : 首先，我大概不会提进监狱那件事。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook2
: Besides the jail thing! I obviously know I’m not supposed to say that!
lines.zh: : 除了进监狱那件事！我当然知道那个不能说！

lines.en: : Just avoid any scenario that makes you look bad. Be vague or something.
lines.zh: : 就避开任何会让你显得很糟的场景。说得含糊点什么的。

lines.en: : Tell them your dreams. Aspirations. Any of those things that normal girls have.
lines.zh: : 跟他们说说你的梦想。抱负。那些正常女孩会有的东西。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook3
: Sorry for not being a fucking “normal girl.” Not everyone knows what they want to do with their life, you know?
lines.zh: : 抱歉我不是那种“正常的女孩”。不是所有人都知道自己这辈子想干什么，你知道吗？

lines.en: : We can’t all just fuckin’...become [high_school] teachers and spend our days fingerbanging our students.
lines.zh: : 我们又不能都他妈去当[high_school]老师，整天用手指插学生。

lines.en: : I had no idea you were so interested in my career.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你对我这行这么感兴趣。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook2
: I’m not interested in your fucking career! Obviously, I don’t want to be a teacher!
lines.zh: : 我对你他妈的职业没兴趣！显然，我不想当老师！

lines.en: : I’m just sayin’ that you shouldn’t expect a girl my age to have fucking everything figured out!
lines.zh: : 我只是说，你不该指望一个我这个年纪的女孩什么都他妈想明白了！

lines.en: It’s been a long time since I was Yumi’s age, but she’s right.
lines.zh: 我已经不是 Yumi 这个年纪很久了，但她是对的。

lines.en: Perhaps I’m being a little too hard on her?
lines.zh: 也许我对她有点太苛刻了？

lines.en: Your first part-time job should be as simple as just...knowing the ‘right’ answers to interview questions.
lines.zh: 第一份兼职工作，本该简单到……只要知道面试问题的“标准答案”就行。

lines.en: So trying to coax even more out of her is essentially hopeless at this point in time.
lines.zh: 所以在这个阶段，想从她身上再挤出更多东西，基本上是没指望的。

lines.en: She needs to learn how to crawl before she can walk. And she needs to fail repeatedly in order to do either of those two things.
lines.zh: 她得先学会爬，才能学会走。而要做到这两件事，她都得反复失败才行。

lines.en: But even with that being said, I can't just abandon her in the middle of a busy road and hope she dodges traffic without the ability to move herself in any direction.
lines.zh: 可即便如此，我也不能把她丢在车水马龙的马路中间，然后指望她在动弹不得的情况下躲开车辆。

lines.en: I'll help her cross for now.
lines.zh: 现在，我来扶她过马路。

lines.en: I'll help her so if she ever does get hit, I won't have myself to blame for it.
lines.zh: 我来帮她，这样万一她真被撞了，我也怪不到自己头上。

lines.en: : Just try saying something like...”In ten years, I hope to be settled into a career that I can grow and advance with.”
lines.zh: : 就试着说点像……「十年后，我希望能安定在一份可以让我成长、让我晋升的职业里。」

lines.en: : Or talk about how you’re going to go to law[school] or something. I’m pretty sure that takes around fifty years to complete, though.
lines.zh: : 或者说说你要去读法[school]什么的。不过我敢肯定，那个得花上五十年才能读完。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook9
: Me? A lawyer? That’s rich.
lines.zh: : 我？当律师？真能想。

lines.en: : Would kill to see the look on my dad’s face if that ever happened.
lines.zh: : 要是真能成，我死都想看看我爸的表情。

lines.en: : Does he not have great expectations for you or something?
lines.zh: : 他对你没什么厚望之类的吗？

lines.en: scene yuminotebook10
: Would you have great expectations with a daughter like me?
lines.zh: : 换成你，有个我这样的女儿，你会有厚望吗？

lines.en: : Isn’t Ami like, already a fucking homemaker in her freshman year of [high_school]? She’s way ahead of the game.
lines.zh: : Ami 不是才[high_school]一年级就已经是个该死的家庭主妇了吗？她可比我领先太多了。

lines.en: : I can’t even make an omelette.
lines.zh: : 我连个煎蛋卷都做不出来。

lines.en: : Fuck, I can’t even afford an omelette.
lines.zh: : 操，我连个煎蛋卷都买不起。

lines.en: : I’ve got no interests. No talent. No work experience. No work ethic. I’ve gotten into more fights than I can even remember.
lines.zh: : 我没有兴趣爱好。没有才能。没有工作经验。没有职业道德。我打过的架多得我自己都数不清。

lines.en: : Course my dad doesn’t have great expectations of me. Why would he when I ain't given him a reason to?
lines.zh: : 我爸当然对我没什么厚望。我都没给过他理由，他凭什么？

lines.en: scene yuminotebook11
: But now that I know what to tell my interviewer, I’m as good as gold.
lines.zh: : 不过现在我知道该跟面试官说什么了，我就跟捡了金子一样。

lines.en: : If you’ve got weaknesses, just fuckin’ hide ‘em from people until you get what you want out of ‘em.
lines.zh: : 你要是有弱点，就他妈的把它们藏起来，藏到从别人那儿拿到你想要的东西为止。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook7
: What? Why are you all fuckin’ quiet all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 干嘛？你怎么突然他妈的不说话了？

lines.en: : Sorry. I'm just not really used to relating to anything you say and that actually made sense to me.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是不习惯对你说的话产生共鸣，而这句确实说到我心里去了。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook3
: Well, don't relate too much, dickweed. I’m nothing like you. I’m nothing like anyone.
lines.zh: : 那你也别太共鸣了，蠢货。我跟你一点都不像。我跟谁都不像。

lines.en: : I’m my own fuckin’ person and, if you don’t like it, you can get the fuck out of my room.
lines.zh: : 我就是我自己，你要是不喜欢，可以他妈的滚出我的房间。

lines.en: : That probably wouldn’t be a good idea. Interviews are normally more than one question and I’m pretty sure that one won’t even be asked since it's extremely cliche.
lines.zh: : 那大概不是个好主意。面试通常不止一个问题，而且我敢肯定那一题根本不会被问到，因为它太老套了。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook8
: Wait, for real? I thought that was like, one of the textbook interview questions.
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？我还以为那是教科书式的面试问题之一。

lines.en: : It used to be. But now, most businesses you'll be applying to just want to test your people-skills or something like that.
lines.zh: : 以前是。但现在你要去应聘的大多数店家，只想测试你的人际交往能力之类的。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook2
: Well, then why the fuck have we been rambling on about the other question for so long?!
lines.zh: : 那我们他妈的为什么还要为另一个问题唠叨这么久？！

lines.en: : You seemed pretty dead-set on finding out an acceptable answer so I just kind of went along with it.
lines.zh: : 你看起来一门心思要找出一个能被接受的答案，我就顺着你来了。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook12
: Jesus, fuck. This is so fucking stupid...
lines.zh: : 天哪，操。这简直蠢透了……

lines.en: : Are you sure my TV business won’t work out?
lines.zh: : 你确定我的电视生意不会成？

lines.en: : Maybe I just need to figure out how to get my hands on some of the newer models or something.
lines.zh: : 也许我只要想办法搞到几台新一点的型号就行了。

lines.en: : You should really stop calling that a business, Yumi.
lines.zh: : Yumi，你真该别再把那叫作生意了。

lines.en: : Besides, for this next interview, I’m pretty sure all of your questions are just going to be about noodles.
lines.zh: : 再说，这次面试，我敢肯定你所有的问题都会是关于面条的。

lines.en: : Practicing conventional interview tactics will help you further down the road, but...
lines.zh: : 练习常规的面试技巧对你以后有帮助，不过……

lines.en: : Well, let’s just say that Tsuneyo isn’t the most conventional person out there.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这么说吧——Tsuneyo 可不是什么循规蹈矩的人。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook6
: How much is there to know about fucking noodles? They’re noodles.
lines.zh: : 面条有什么他妈好了解的？那就是面条啊。

lines.en: : Just talk about how great they are or something. I’m sure that will get her attention.
lines.zh: : 就说它们有多棒之类的。我敢肯定那能引起她的注意。

lines.en: : I feel like you’re setting me up for failure.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你是在给我挖坑。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have come all the way over here just to torment you.
lines.zh: : 我不会特意跑这么远，就为了折磨你。

lines.en: : You absolutely would have come all the way over here to torment me. That’s literally all you ever do.
lines.zh: : 你绝对会特意跑这么远来折磨我。这就是你一直在干的事。

lines.en: : Wanting to torment you and wanting to see you are two different things.
lines.zh: : 想折磨你，和想见你，是两码事。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook13
: Yeah, whatever. Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 行，随你怎么说。操你的。

lines.en: : But thanks for the noodle tip...which is a weird fucking sentence now that I've said it out loud.
lines.zh: : 不过谢谢你的面条建议……说出来才发现这句话真他妈怪。

lines.en: : I’ve just got a feeling this interview thing is going to be weird as shit, so I’m not gonna get my hopes up or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 我就是觉得这次面试肯定会怪得要命，所以我不会抱什么希望之类的。

lines.en: : The sooner I get an actual job, the sooner the two of us can split and not have to go back and forth like this anymore.
lines.zh: : 我越早找到一份正经工作，我们俩就能越早分道扬镳，不用再来回折腾了。

lines.en: : Shit’s fucking exhausting. I just want it to end.
lines.zh: : 这破事累死人了。我只想让它赶紧结束。

lines.en: Those words probably would have packed a lot more punch if she hadn’t been looking away, slightly blushing while saying them.
lines.zh: 如果她说这些话的时候没有别过脸、还微微红着脸，那大概会更有分量。

lines.en: Despite her constant beratement of me, I can’t help but feel like Yumi doesn’t hate this as much as she’s letting on.
lines.zh: 尽管她一直在骂我，我总忍不住觉得，Yumi 并没有她表现出来的那么讨厌这一切。

lines.en: Obviously, there’s still a fair bit of very warranted disdain regarding some of my actions with her in the past, but...
lines.zh: 显然，对我过去对她做过的某些事，她仍有相当充分、也相当合理的厌恶，不过……

lines.en: We’ve gotta be getting somewhere. Right?
lines.zh: 我们总该有所进展了吧？对吧？

lines.en: I just hope she doesn’t wind up exploding again if this ramen shop thing doesn’t go as planned.
lines.zh: 我只希望如果拉面店这事不如计划，她别又当场爆炸。

lines.en: The important part is not getting her hopes up too high, which is something I may have let happen last time- so I'm glad to hear she's attempting to avoid that.
lines.zh: 重要的是别让她抱太高的期望——上次我可能就让她抱了——所以我很高兴听到她在试着避免这一点。

lines.en: And hey, who knows? Maybe if Yumi just...continuously tells Tsuneyo how great noodles are, Tsuneyo won’t know how to refuse?
lines.zh: 再说，谁知道呢？也许只要 Yumi 一直……不停告诉 Tsuneyo 面条有多棒，Tsuneyo 就会不知道该怎么拒绝？

lines.en: : If you want this partnership to end that desperately, try this out during your interview.
lines.zh: : 如果你真那么急着结束这段合作关系，面试时就试试这个。

lines.en: : But keep in mind, this strategy will work literally nowhere else.
lines.zh: : 不过记住，这套策略在别的地方绝对行不通。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook10
: Just tell me the fuckin’ strategy. We’ll worry about other interviews when it comes time for them.
lines.zh: : 直接把他妈的策略告诉我。别的面试等到了再说。

lines.en: : The only words you are allowed to say during your entire meeting are...
lines.zh: : 你在整场会面中唯一被允许说的话是……

lines.en: : “I love noodles.”
lines.zh: : “我爱面条。”

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m not doing that.
lines.zh: : 行，我不会那么干。

lines.en: : Yumi, you have to trust me on this.
lines.zh: : Yumi，这件事你得相信我。

lines.en: : I really don’t. That’s a horrible plan.
lines.zh: : 我真不信。那是个烂透了的计划。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook12
: I’ll just fuckin’ figure something else out. You’re clearly just trying to sabotage me again for the sole purpose of getting to spend more time with me or some shit.
lines.zh: : 我他妈自己另想办法。你显然只是又想坑我，目的就是为了能多跟我待一会儿什么的。

lines.en: : In fact, I doubt you want me to get a job at all. You’re just trying to add me to your gross-ass harem and this is your idea of the...easiest way to do that.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我怀疑你根本就不想让我找到工作。你只是想把我加进你那个恶心的后宫，而这大概就是你觉得……最省事的办法。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook11
: But get this, douchebag. Each time I fuck up an interview, I come one step closer to nailing the next one.
lines.zh: : 但你给我听好了，混蛋。每次我把面试搞砸，我就离搞定下一次近了一步。

lines.en: : Pretty soon, you won’t have a reason to see me anymore.
lines.zh: : 很快，你就再也找不到理由来见我了。

lines.en: : And I’ll have some extra cash as well since I won’t be buying you lunch every weekend.
lines.zh: : 而且我还能多出点闲钱，毕竟我不用每周末都请你吃午饭了。

lines.en: : Exactly. It’s a win-win situation.
lines.zh: : 没错。双赢。

lines.en: scene yuminotebook13
: So how about you do us both a favor and just...get out of here.
lines.zh: : 所以，你就行行好，帮我们俩个忙，滚出去吧。

lines.en: : I need to figure out a way to handle this that doesn’t make me look like a complete fucking moron.
lines.zh: : 我得想个办法应对这事，别让自己看起来像个彻头彻尾的傻逼。

lines.en: : Sure, Yumi. But I really think you should at least consider-
lines.zh: : 好，Yumi。但我真的觉得你至少该考虑——

lines.en: scene yuminotebook2
: I SAID GET THE FUCK OUT!
lines.zh: : 我说了给我滚出去！

lines.en: scene black
Okay, so it looks like Yumi isn’t going to take my noodle suggestion.
lines.zh: 好吧，看来 Yumi 是不会接受我的面条建议了。

lines.en: Joke's on her, though.
lines.zh: 不过，笑话在她那边。

lines.en: I know Tsuneyo, and I know what she wants to hear.
lines.zh: 我了解 Tsuneyo，也知道她想听什么。

lines.en: And I’m not sure if someone with Yumi’s narrow-mindedness will be able to figure that out in such a short period of time.
lines.zh: 而我不确定像 Yumi 这种心眼窄的人，能不能在这么短的时间里琢磨明白。

lines.en: But, either way-
lines.zh: 但不管怎样——

lines.en: I still feel like we got somewhere tonight.
lines.zh: 我还是觉得今晚我们有所进展。

lines.en: Even if I’m walking home significantly earlier than I planned.
lines.zh: 哪怕我要比原计划早得多地走回家。
